doc.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Closing remarks and tonight's soprano set
summary: Thanks and goodbyes; he will play soprano with Ralph and surprise him with Poor Butterfly.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’ve enjoyed talking with you today.
Oh it’s been a pleasure, yeah.
And I wish you all the best.
And I hope to hear your soprano sax again tonight.

Oh, yeah, I’m going to play tonight, yeah. I’m going to play with Ralph tonight. The first set tonight is with Ralph, so I love to play the soprano with Ralph. I’m going to surprise him and play “Poor Butterfly” tonight. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -14-
